title: A New Morning: Lin's Sleep and Exercise Plan
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成8道题。题目有单选、填空和判断（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
Lin is a 28-year-old office worker in Chengdu. Last year, she had a bad habit. She went to bed at 1 a.m. because she watched videos on her phone. She felt tired every morning. She drank three cups of coffee a day, so she was very nervous. Coffee made her feel worried and stressed. She did not exercise, so her back hurt. She sat at her desk all day, and this was not good for her body.

In March, Lin changed her routine. Now she goes to bed at 11 p.m. because she wants to sleep eight hours. Sleep helps her feel good. She puts her phone in the kitchen, so she cannot watch videos in bed. The kitchen is far from her bed, so she must get up to use her phone. She gets up at 7 a.m. and runs in the park for 20 minutes. Running is cheaper than the gym, and it is more fun for her. She also does yoga on Sunday. Yoga is the most relaxing exercise for her.

Lin says, "I should sleep more and worry less." Her friends say she looks happier now. Her back does not hurt. She still drinks coffee, but only one cup in the morning. She thinks sleep is the most important thing for health.

questions.prompt: Why did Lin go to bed at 1 a.m. last year?
options: Because she watched videos on her phone.
Because she ran in the park.
answers: Because she watched videos on her phone.
questions.explanation: 原文说“She went to bed at 1 a.m. because she watched videos on her phone.”，所以选第一个。
questions.evidence: She went to bed at 1 a.m. because she watched videos on her phone.

questions.prompt: What time does Lin go to bed now?
questions.explanation: 原文说“Now she goes to bed at 11 p.m.”，所以选第一个。
questions.evidence: Now she goes to bed at 11 p.m. because she wants to sleep eight hours.

questions.prompt: Lin runs in the park for ______ minutes.
questions.explanation: 原文说“runs in the park for 20 minutes”，所以填20。
questions.evidence: She gets up at 7 a.m. and runs in the park for 20 minutes.

questions.prompt: Which exercise is the most relaxing for Lin?
questions.explanation: 原文说“Yoga is the most relaxing exercise for her.”，所以选Yoga。
questions.evidence: Yoga is the most relaxing exercise for her.

questions.explanation: 原文说“She did not exercise, so her back hurt.”，所以是True。
questions.evidence: She did not exercise, so her back hurt.

questions.explanation: 原文说“She also does yoga on Sunday.”，不是Saturday，所以是False。
questions.evidence: She also does yoga on Sunday.

questions.prompt: Lin's friends say she looks happier now.
questions.explanation: 原文说“Her friends say she looks happier now.”，所以是True。
questions.evidence: Her friends say she looks happier now.

questions.prompt: Lin drinks coffee in the afternoon now.
questions.explanation: 原文说“She still drinks coffee, but only one cup in the morning.”，没有说下午喝，所以是False。
questions.evidence: She still drinks coffee, but only one cup in the morning.

grammar.title: because / so；should；比较级与最高级入门
grammar.explanation: because 表示原因，后面接原因；so 表示结果，后面接结果。should 表示“应该”，后面接动词原形。比较级用于两者比较，如 cheaper（更便宜）、more fun（更有趣）；最高级用于三者或以上比较，如 the most relaxing（最放松的）、the most important（最重要的）。
grammar.example: She went to bed at 1 a.m. because she watched videos on her phone.

questions.prompt: Tom was tired ______ he worked late.
questions.explanation: “他工作到很晚”是原因，所以用because。
questions.evidence: Tom was tired because he worked late.

questions.prompt: It was cold, ______ we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: “天气冷”是原因，“我们待在家”是结果，所以用so。
questions.evidence: It was cold, so we stayed at home.

questions.prompt: A bike is ______ than a car.
questions.evidence: A bike is cheaper than a car.

questions.prompt: This is ______ book in the shop.
questions.explanation: 三者以上比较用最高级the most interesting。
questions.evidence: This is the most interesting book in the shop.
She should go to bed early.

questions.prompt: I was hungry, ______ I ate an apple.
questions.explanation: “我饿了”是原因，“我吃了一个苹果”是结果，所以用so。
questions.evidence: I was hungry, so I ate an apple.
